_comment: The research trails. Each thread runs left to right: `roots` (who it serves), then its papers (`levels` flattened oldest-first), then `deployment` if it has one; a thread with no `deployment` ends at its last paper. `stage` is kept for the agent/llms outputs. `clip` picks the looping illustration next to the trail (retrieval | health | router). `short` is the stop label on the trail. Slugs must match filenames in src/papers/.
intro: Seven papers, three trails. Each starts with the people it is for, runs through the papers, and ends where the work is headed. Pick a trail to filter the papers below.
